root_idea.summary: The root centers on rising, elevation, and emergence: something rises, comes forth, grows, or is brought into being.
root_idea.development: From physical rising and becoming elevated, the lexical range develops toward growth, emergence, creation, formation, and the production of new forms or states. Related extensions include composing speech and seeking something by raising it toward the senses.

senses.definition: To rear, bring up, or foster to growth.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran attests the passive form, describing someone brought up or reared in adornment.

senses.definition: To bring into being; create, originate, or produce.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic uses include bringing people, communities, bodily forms, and a later creation into existence. The construction is especially associated with divine creation and production.

senses.definition: To raise, form, or bring forth progressively.
senses.usage_conditions: This developmental aspect is used of clouds as they form and rise and of living beings as they are brought into growth; it remains a form of bringing something into being rather than a merely physical elevation.

senses.definition: Bringing into being; creation or formative production.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression concerning the creation of the inhabitants of Paradise, the verbal noun denotes a distinctive act of bringing into being and forming.

The Quranic plural مُنْشَآت describes ships with their sails raised. The expression is also associated in transmitted interpretations with ships raising their sails, advancing and retiring, or commencing their courses.

senses.definition: Those who bring into being or produce.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle occurs in a contrast between human production and divine production.

senses.definition: A rising at night; a nocturnal rising or vigil.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic phrase نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ, the term is explained especially as rising and standing for night prayer. It is also interpreted as the first part or hours of the night, or repeated rising after sleep.
The noun can denote an originating or first creation, as in the Quranic reference to the first creation.

senses.definition: The other or latter creation; resurrection and the life to come.
senses.usage_conditions: In the fixed expressions النَّشْأَةُ الْآخِرَةُ and النَّشْأَةُ الْأُخْرَى, the noun denotes the subsequent creation understood as resurrection or the latter life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To live.
To rise, become elevated, or become high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general intransitive use of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grow up and become a youth or young man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person growing from childhood toward youth or manhood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a cloud, to rise and appear at its first formation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression concerns the first appearance or beginning of a cloud's rise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To originate or come into being from something else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may be followed by عَنْ to indicate origin from another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To happen, occur, or come to pass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event or occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an opinion, to arise in the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression نَشَأَ لَهُ رَأْىٌ, an opinion occurs to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set up a beacon or sign of the way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of placing a visible guide or landmark in a desert or on a highway.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to attain or approach the age of manhood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative maturation use, distinct from the broader sense of creating or producing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To found or begin building a house or similar structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of initiating construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To formulate or compose a proverb, phrase, or literary language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the deliberate construction of verbal expression, including an ode or similar composition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recite poetry or a sermon well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use concerns skilled oral delivery rather than composition alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To forge a tradition and attribute it to the Prophet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for fabricating and ascribing a report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin to relate, say, or do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inchoative construction is followed by an imperfect verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth from a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَنْشَأَ مِنْهُ asks or states from where someone has come forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to conceive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal use attributed to Hudhayl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to, advance toward, or approach someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise and go to accomplish one's affair or business.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may describe rising and going energetically or running to complete an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scent or sniff the wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal, especially a wolf, testing the wind by scent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or search after news.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use may occur with or without the hamza in the cited dialectal variation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To request someone to compose or recite an ode or similar poem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited expression permits either composition or recitation as the requested act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first rising or appearance of clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to risen clouds, their first appearance, or clouds spread out like a piece of drapery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exhalation or odor of wine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young ones of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a plural or quasi-plural designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A structural first or base part of a tank or cistern, including its bottom stone or surrounding earth; also earth removed from a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical vocabulary of tanks, cisterns, and wells, with several closely related applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh, green, newly sprouted plant growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of vegetation that has sprung up but has not yet become thick or dry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young person or youth past childhood or puberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can apply to either a boy or a girl and may also denote a youth who has attained adult stature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud not yet completely gathered together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cloud meaning is associated with the image of something newly arising or not yet fully formed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or source from which something originates, literally or figuratively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place or source of origination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A raised and pointed beacon or sign of the way; also an elevated hill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a visibly raised landmark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that has conceived.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal use attributed to Hudhayl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female diviner who seeks or searches after news.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is also recorded as the proper name of a particular female diviner; an alternative etymological explanation connects it with originating.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to the preceding entry.

cautions: The Quranic expression نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ has closely related interpretations: night prayer or standing, the first part or hours of night, and rising after sleep; these are retained as usage nuances rather than separate lexical forms.

The Quranic مُنْشَآت is presented under the singular passive-participle citation form مُنْشَأَة; transmitted interpretations of the associated ship expression include both elevated sails and variant motion-related readings.
